description: Extra video settings for Minecraft 1.7.10 implemented with Mixins

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
 - Added Biomes O' Plenty leaf mode support
 - Added "Disable Horizon" option by @starturtle27 in https://github.com/jss2a98aj/NotFine/pull/61
 - Use MixinBuilder when applying mixins
 - Update zh_CN.lang by @Omgise in https://github.com/jss2a98aj/NotFine/pull/59
 - Hodgepodge's async icon loading compat from Angelica
 - RenderItemFrame leaking fix from Angelica
 - Invert Horizon and Terrain Fog toggles from Angelica

## New Contributors
 - @starturtle27 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jss2a98aj/NotFine/pull/61

- Added an OptionPage event so other mods can add or replace options.
- Removed built-in CTM textures.
- Fixed a MCP:F conflict with another mod.

- Entirely removed MCPF renderpass changes
- Made the RenderBlocks mixin less invasive

From 0.2.6 (unreleased)
- Fixed a potential crash relating to anvils and CTM.
- Optimized fancy cloud rendering. Please report issues if any arise.
- Added a terrain fog toggle - upstreamed from Angelica
- Disabled MCPatcher Forge features by default. They will be re-enabled as they are rewritten
- Fixed a crash with OpenAutism - brandyn
- Updated zh_CN.lang - Omgise
- Updated pl_PL.lang - Rad

- Improved Bookshelf connected textures.
- Added Sandstone connected textures.
- Added interpolated icon support. - Roadhog360
- Fixed smooth lighting on doors and improve face culling.
- Face culling optimization for the enchanting table.
- Updated zh_CN.lang - Omgise

- Added near fog distance percentage slider by MellowArpeggiation
- Removed unneeded debug log message in MCPatcherForge CIT module
